summary: Iran's IRGC launched missile attacks on at least two commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, damaging two ships and ending a week-long US-Iran truce, with Axios reporting possible US military retaliation. Simultaneously, Israeli forces eliminated three senior Hamas commanders in Gaza, including the head of the Nukhba training department. In Damascus, two explosions occurred near French President Macron's location, wounding four Syrian police officers.

US-Iran one-week truce in Strait of Hormuz ended; Axios suggests US may strike Iranian targets in response. (Source: @VahidOnline/76797)
IDF eliminated Hamas training department commander Fadi Falach Ashour Daqmash in northern Gaza via airstrike. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542)
IDF killed Nukhba squad commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and Hamas military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daka in southern Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9294)
Two explosions in Damascus near Macron's hotel, caused by IEDs in trash cans, four Syrian police injured; Macron unharmed. (Source: @yediotnews25/132348)
Iranian TV announces Khamenei's funeral processions in Najaf and Karbala on Wednesday; Sistani will not lead prayers due to health. (Source: @VahidOnline/76798)

Israeli warplanes conducting military exercise over Lebanese airspace; IDF struck four suspects approaching security zone in southern Lebanon near Al-Aqida. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374998, @almogboker78/17656)
Unknown explosion near "Chinese Prison" in Al-Shaddadi, southern Hasakah, Syria. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81312)

points: IRGC fired at least two missiles at commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, damaging two vessels; Iranian state TV claimed the Qatari tanker "Al-Raqayyat" ignored repeated warnings before being targeted, though Tehran has not officially claimed responsibility. (Source: @VahidOnline/76797)

The week-long US-Iran truce halting attacks in the Strait of Hormuz has expired; Axios cites US officials warning that Washington may strike Iranian targets in retaliation, raising immediate escalation risks. (Source: @VahidOnline/76797)

Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral processions are scheduled for Wednesday: 6:00 AM in Najaf and afternoon in Karbala; Grand Ayatollah Sistani declined to lead prayers over the coffin citing poor health, a notable absence interpreted as a potential fracture in Shiite leadership cohesion. (Source: @VahidOnline/76798, @naya_foriraq/81311)

Tehran's Revolutionary Court Branch 15 sentenced Mehdi Nazer to death and his wife Mahnaz Charadoli and sister Attafeh Nazer to 10 years each for unspecified charges, reflecting ongoing internal repression. (Source: @VahidOnline/76791)

IDF confirmed elimination of Hamas training department commander Fadi Falach Ashour Daqmash in northern Gaza via airstrike; he oversaw Nukhba commando training before October 7 and recently attempted to rebuild Hamas capabilities. (Source: @idf_telegram/24542)

IDF also killed Nukhba squad commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh in northern Gaza and Hamas military intelligence commander Hamouda Abu Daka in southern Gaza within the past 48 hours, degrading Hamas command structures. (Source: @inon_yttach/9294)

IDF struck a vehicle with four suspects approaching the security zone near Al-Aqida in southern Lebanon, removing an immediate threat to Israeli forces operating in the area. (Source: @almogboker78/17656)

Unverified social media claims suggest Israeli forces raised the Israeli flag on Ali Taher hill near Nabatieh, site of the Iranian-built Imad-4 missile base reportedly under siege for 20 days; no official confirmation. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74841)

Three senior Hamas commanders eliminated in 48 hours: training chief Fadi Falach Ashour Daqmash (northern Gaza), Nukhba commander Ahmed Yahya Ibrahim Batsh (northern Gaza), and military intelligence chief Hamouda Abu Daka (southern Gaza). (Source: @idf_telegram/24542, @inon_yttach/9294)

sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC's resumption of attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz marks a dangerous escalation, directly challenging the expired US-Iran truce and inviting potential American military retaliation against Iranian assets. Simultaneously, Israel's systematic decapitation of Hamas's military leadership — eliminating training, commando, and intelligence commanders within 48 hours — indicates a sustained campaign to degrade Hamas's regenerative capacity in Gaza. The Damascus explosions during Macron's visit, while likely not targeting the French president, demonstrate the persistent instability in Syria and the risk of miscalculation with foreign dignitaries present. The snub of Khamenei's funeral by Grand Ayatollah Sistani exposes a potential fracture in transnational Shiite authority that could complicate Iran's influence projection in Iraq.
sections.regional_response: The United States faces immediate pressure to respond militarily to the Hormuz attacks after Axios reported the truce collapse, with Trump's stated preference for a deal contradicted by his "finish the job" rhetoric. NATO's $40 billion anti-drone investment, announced at the Ankara summit attended by Trump and Erdogan, signals a long-term Western focus on aerial threats emanating from Iran and its proxies. European allies, exemplified by Belgium's defense minister, emphasize continued reliance on US security guarantees for at least a decade, limiting independent European action. In Iraq, Sistani's refusal to participate in Khamenei's funeral ceremonies may restrain Iran-backed factions from aggressive posturing during the mourning period.
sections.intelligence_notes: The coordinated elimination of three Hamas commanders across northern and southern Gaza suggests precise intelligence penetration of Hamas's command structure, possibly enabled by human sources or signals intelligence. The IRGC's use of missiles against commercial shipping — rather than drones or mines — indicates a deliberate escalation in weapon choice to ensure destruction and send a political message. The Damascus IEDs placed in trash cans near a high-profile diplomatic visit reflect either sophisticated targeting or opportunistic attack by local actors exploiting security gaps. The unverified claim of Israeli control over the Imad-4 missile base on Ali Taher hill, if confirmed, would represent a significant strategic gain, neutralizing a key Iranian missile asset in southern Lebanon. Monitoring of Sistani's health and public statements will be critical for assessing Shiite leadership cohesion post-Khamenei.
